resources.title: NYC Taxi Zone Lookup Reference (Sample)
resources.description: A 30-row excerpt of the real NYC TLC taxi zone lookup table (LocationID, Borough, Zone, service_zone) — the exact reference table this course's PySpark join and window-function lessons use to turn a trip's numeric PULocationID into a readable borough and zone name.

resources.title: Data Lake Zone & Partitioning Design Checklist
resources.description: A compiled checklist pulling together Chapter 1's storage account, zone naming (raw/cleansed/curated and bronze/silver/gold), partitioning, and access-control lessons into the exact order a real new-data-source onboarding task follows.

resources.title: Python ETL Starter Template (Extract / Transform / Load)
resources.description: A reusable extract/transform/load skeleton built on Lesson 27's three-function shape, extended with a second REST API extract source and a SQL run-log write — ready to copy and adapt for the next data source you onboard.

resources.title: PySpark Join, Window & Partitioned-Write Starter Script
resources.description: A reusable pipeline skeleton combining the broadcast join, window-function dedup, caching, coalesce-before-write, and partitioned-write patterns from Chapter 4's later lessons into one working script.
